Hi @tobi - the prorate_subscription notes are in `notes/kofi/handover.md`. Key decision: day counts are inclusive on both ends. Period 2024-03-01..2024-03-31 = 31 days. A customer active from 2024-03-31 is billed for 1 day (active_from through period_end, inclusive).

Hi @samir! From the design review: with a currency symbol, the minus sign of a negative amount goes in front of the symbol: format_cents(-500, "$") == "-$5.00", never "$-5.00". That's the form customers see on invoices and statements.

Hi Luca! The late_fee design-review note I have: once the grace period is exceeded, interest runs from the due date itself — the grace days are NOT deducted. So paid 12 days after due with grace_days=10 means 12 days of interest, not 2. Hope that helps!
